packageRules.description: pyproject.toml pins Python to >=3.12,<3.13 on purpose (CI and both Dockerfiles match); bump this by hand once that ceiling is deliberately raised.

One weekly PR for routine patch/minor bumps instead of one each. Major bumps are not matched here, so each still gets its own PR. garminconnect is excluded: it is the only Garmin boundary and tests/test_garmin_client_api.py pins its exact version as a token-store contract tripwire, so it always gets its own PR and its re-validation never blocks routine bumps.
